reference: CoolProp HEOS CO2 tubing march RK4 N=2000 with Colebrook via bench-src/ref/gen_co2storage.py
reference_citations: Span R., Wagner W. (1996) J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 25:1509
Bell I.H. et al. (2014) CoolProp, Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 53:2498
Bachu S. et al. (2007) IJGGC 1:430 (CSLF storage capacity)
tolerance: wellbore: WHP within 0.5 bar, hydrostatic term 0.5 %, friction 3 % (tool uses Swamee-Jain, 100 predictor-corrector steps); solve: well count N and N+spare exact, WHP 0.5 bar, BHP/P50 capacity/J/q_res/LCOS 0.2 %, capex and reservoir p/T/BHP_max 1e-6
scope: wellbore tubing pressure profile (24 cases) + full solve (12 cases: 6 presets + 6 variants): reservoir p/T, P50 capacity, Darcy injectivity, phase-dependent velocity well sizing, WHP, capex, LCOS vs independent CoolProp reference (b01 ref_solve)
